WATCH: Lost 'N Sound 2026

Lost ‘N Sound brings you vibrant music across multiple venues in South Main Village and Trinity Metro has the options to get you there!

Video: Trinity Metro on YouTube

story.title: Lost 'N Sound 2026
story.summary: Lost ‘N Sound brings you vibrant music across multiple venues in South Main Village and Trinity Metro has the options to get you there! 🚆 Ride TEXRail or TRE to Fort Worth T&P Station and take a short walk from there 🚌 Catch the route 5 bus to South Main 🚲 Hop on a Trinity Metro bike from your nearest docking station 🚐 Ride the free event shuttle, sponsored by Trinity Metro, between venues Visit lostnsound.org for event information and use the GoPass app or visit ridetrinitymetro.org/trip-planner/ to plan your trip today!
